6. Ārāmadūsakajātaka Spoiling the Park: a past life story

“Na ve anatthakusalena, Surely not with one who misunderstands the meaning atthacariyā sukhāvahā; does good conduct lead to happiness. Hāpeti atthaṁ dummedho, The simpleton destroys the good, kapi ārāmiko yathā”ti. like the monkey groundskeeper.

Ārāmadūsakajātakaṁ chaṭṭhaṁ.
